one_liner: A senior Marine Corps contracting officer-track role at Quantico planning, negotiating, and administering complex FAR, CSO, and OTA contracts for major programs.
fit_summary: This NH-3 role requires a year of GS-11-level experience in FAR-based contracting, Commercial Solutions Openings, Other Transaction Authority and cost and price evaluation. Daniel's proposal writing and supply purchasing at IEM are contractor-side and don't include price evaluation, so he is unlikely to qualify.
eligibility: Open to the public (hiring path: public), so U.S. citizens without federal status are eligible.

At least one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-11/NH-02 in FAR contracting (commercial and noncommercial), CSO, and OTA procedures; long-term pre-/post-award actions; and cost and pricing evaluation.
Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance required, which means a lengthy background investigation and eligibility for SCI access.
This is a public notice flyer, not an application portal; applications go through separate 'How to Apply' directions.
Resume is limited to 2 pages; DoD 1102 roles typically also carry acquisition certification and education requirements.
strategy: Skip this one: it requires a year of GS-11-level FAR contracting with cost and price evaluation, and his IEM proposal writing and supply purchasing were contractor-side work.
Entry-level GS-1102 contract specialist roles open to the public (GS-5/7/9) are where his proposal and procurement work can count.
resume_bullets: Found multimillion-dollar opportunities in SAM.gov, GovWin, BidPro and the DHS acquisition forecast, and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
Procured supplies and set up vendor relationships for COVID-19 sites in six states (2021–2022).
interview_questions: Walk us through how you would choose between a FAR-based contract, a Commercial Solution Opening, and an Other Transaction agreement for a prototype requirement.
Describe a time you evaluated cost or pricing data and what you concluded.
How have you handled a contractor missing a critical milestone?
How do you keep complex approvals on schedule when multiple stakeholders are involved?
watch_outs: The qualification bar is high: without documented FAR/OTA contracting and pricing experience, you will likely be rated not qualified.
The SCI clearance requirement can delay your start date for months.
This is an anticipated-vacancy flyer; positions may never be filled, and no Notice of Result letters will be sent.
The posting lists no promotion potential, so NH-3 is the ceiling for this role.
